recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20463; any future change to this extension SearchParameter should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-20463 was a Published/Persuasive R4 technical correction for Patient asking that the Mother's Maiden Name SearchParameter expression use extension('http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-mothersMaidenName') instead of the SearchParameter canonical URL.
initial_application: Core history shows explicit application in git 9a6b7d6d58 for GF#20463, followed by the tightly related FHIR-20462 commit 91961fdc8d correcting the generated SearchParameter XML from StructureDefinition/patient-extensions-Patient-mothersMaidenName to StructureDefinition/patient-mothersMaidenName.
additional_context: Later cleanup removed Patient extension SearchParameter XML files from core, and the FHIR Extension Pack move commit 04b0747 added the matching sources under input/definitions. The Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* as resources, and the current SearchParameter-profile-patient-extensions-Patient-mothersMaidenName.xml contains the corrected expression. Core source only retains examples and OID records for this extension/search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source is already correct and there is no in-scope core source edit to make.
